create_AwesomeAlignWrapper: create an AwesomeAlignWrapper instance to align bilingual word pairs using the awesome-align model
run_embed_words: run embed_words on a list of words to get embeddings and subword to word mapping
run_align_single_pair: run align_single_pair on source and target word lists to find mutual alignments above threshold
run_force_align_single_pair: run force_align_single_pair to get sure alignments and extra alignments covering all unaligned words
review_reverse_mapping: review the reverse_mapping function that maps word indices to lists of subword indices
